title: AlgoTime Winter 2026
description: Welcome to Algotime Winter 2026! Practice these key algorithm problems to sharpen your skills.

units.title: Week 1
units.description: These are the questions that will be looked at in week 1.

units.title: Week 2
units.description: Warm up with strings, then dive into linked list fundamentals and cycle detection.

units.title: Week 4
units.description: Binary trees fundamentals: comparison, traversal, and tree properties.

units.title: Week 5
units.description: Build recursive thinking from simple base cases to divide & conquer and backtracking.

units.title: Week 6
units.description: Transform recursive solutions into efficient dynamic programs — from memoization to tabulation.

units.title: Week 7
units.description: Explore graph representations, traversals, and classic graph algorithms — from BFS/DFS to topological sort.

units.title: Week 8
units.description: Master heaps and priority queues — from basic heap operations to merging sorted streams and designing real-world systems.

units.title: Week 9
units.description: Master the sliding window technique — from fixed-size windows to dynamic shrinking and expanding for optimal substrings and subarrays.

units.title: Week 10
units.description: Master binary search — from sorted arrays to rotated arrays and binary search on the answer.

units.title: Week 11
units.description: Master the stack data structure — from basic bracket matching and string processing to monotonic stacks for next-greater-element patterns.

units.title: Week 12
units.description: Trie (prefix tree) and string search — warm up with counting on strings, then dictionary words, implement a trie, replace roots in a sentence, and find all words on a board.

units.title: Week 13
units.description: Intervals — sort, merge, and find gaps between intervals. Start with range summaries, check for overlaps, merge intervals, remove the fewest to eliminate overlaps, and find common free time across schedules.

units.title: Week 14
units.description: Greedy algorithms — make the locally-best choice and prove it leads to a global optimum. Pair cookies with children, give lemonade change, track reachability in a jump game, capture every stock gain, and refuel at the right stations to reach the target.

units.title: Week 15
units.description: Review week — revisit core patterns with a mixed set across themes. Warm up with hashing, stacks, binary search, and DP, then tackle sliding window and graph scheduling, finishing with two-pointer rainwater and merging k sorted lists.
